verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence pack says Mistral's API is OpenAI-compatible, offers a drop-in base-URL swap, or documents a migration or adapter path from other providers' SDKs. The official Python/TypeScript SDKs are Mistral's own clients. The 'plan migrations' line refers to moving off retired Mistral models, not switching providers. A `GET /v1/models` endpoint alone does not establish compatibility.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can point existing OpenAI-compatible tooling at the platform, or follow a documented migration/adapter path from other providers' SDKs
